from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initial layout setup
        title = "The Final Link: Arc Length and Pi"
        lines = [
            "Each reflection covers a specific arc angle.",
            "The total bounces depend on the arc length.",
            "Larger mass ratios create smaller, more frequent steps.",
            "The number of steps perfectly calculates Pi's digits.",
            "Pure geometry reveals the secret of the bouncing blocks."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(CYAN)
        
        # Show top semi-circle representing Pi radians in cyan
        radius = 1.8
        semi_circle = Arc(radius=radius, start_angle=0, angle=PI, color=CYAN)
        # Use place_in_area to position the semi-circle on the right side
        self.place_in_area(semi_circle, "B2", "E5")
        
        # Calculate the actual arc center after placement for subsequent elements
        # For a top semi-circle, the bounding box center is radius/2 above the arc origin
        arc_origin = semi_circle.get_center() + DOWN * (radius / 2)
        
        base_line = Line(arc_origin + LEFT * radius, arc_origin + RIGHT * radius, color=GRAY)
        label_pi = MathTex(r"\pi \text{ radians}", color=CYAN)
        self.place_at_grid(label_pi, "B4", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(Create(semi_circle), Create(base_line), Write(label_pi))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Draw a small angle theta representing a single collision.
        theta_val = PI / 10
        theta_arc = Arc(radius=0.7, start_angle=0, angle=theta_val, arc_center=arc_origin, color=YELLOW)
        theta_line_0 = Line(arc_origin, arc_origin + RIGHT * radius, color=YELLOW)
        theta_line_1 = Line(arc_origin, arc_origin + np.array([radius * np.cos(theta_val), radius * np.sin(theta_val), 0]), color=YELLOW)
        
        label_theta = MathTex(r"\theta", color=YELLOW)
        # Position label_theta near the first step
        label_theta.move_to(arc_origin + 1.0 * (RIGHT * np.cos(theta_val/2) + UP * np.sin(theta_val/2)))
        
        self.play(Create(theta_line_0), Create(theta_line_1), Create(theta_arc), Write(label_theta))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Animate multiple theta steps filling the semi-circle arc.
        steps = VGroup()
        for i in range(1, 10):
            angle = (i + 1) * theta_val
            s_line = Line(arc_origin, arc_origin + np.array([radius * np.cos(angle), radius * np.sin(angle), 0]), color=YELLOW, stroke_width=2)
            steps.add(s_line)
        
        self.play(AnimationGroup(*[Create(s) for s in steps], lag_ratio=0.15))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(GREEN)
        
        # Fade out coarse steps to show many fine steps
        self.play(FadeOut(steps), FadeOut(theta_line_1), FadeOut(theta_arc), FadeOut(label_theta))
        
        # Decrease theta size to show more steps (representing larger M)
        num_fine_steps = 31
        fine_steps = VGroup()
        for i in range(1, num_fine_steps + 1):
            angle = i * (PI / num_fine_steps)
            s_line = Line(arc_origin, arc_origin + np.array([radius * np.cos(angle), radius * np.sin(angle), 0]), color=GREEN, stroke_width=1)
            fine_steps.add(s_line)
            
        # Display final collision count matching Pi digits in green
        count_label = Text("314 bounces", color=GREEN)
        self.place_at_grid(count_label, "F3", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        pi_val_label = Text("Digits: 3, 1, 4...", color=GREEN)
        self.place_at_grid(pi_val_label, "F5", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(Create(fine_steps), run_time=2)
        self.play(Write(count_label), Write(pi_val_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE) # Pure geometry
        
        # Summary formula
        final_formula = MathTex(r"\text{Total Bounces} \approx \frac{\pi}{\theta}", color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(final_formula, "D5", scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(Write(final_formula))
        self.wait(2)
